scope.rationale: Cross-cutting changes across OAuth scope policy, Twitch integration lifecycle, EventSub subscription setup, chat command availability, panel state, health projection, documentation, and tests.

integration.rationale: Uses existing Twitch OAuth, Helix, EventSub WebSocket, Twurple, and command services; no new external provider is proposed.

infrastructure.rationale: No new container/service is needed; a persisted mode flag may be unnecessary if eligibility derives the mode. Confirm during implementation planning.

knowledge.rationale: Twitch authorization behavior and separation between Channel Points eligibility and installed chatbot EventSub must be verified precisely.

risk.rationale: Current code shuts down all Twitch integration on ineligibility; changing this boundary could affect OAuth, authorization, chat commands, reward workers, reconciliation, and status reporting.

flags: Do not implement until FND-9 is approved and sequenced
